Ladakh Celebrates First Black-Necked Crane Festival

Ladakh hosted India's first Black-Necked Crane Festival. Lieutenant Governor V.K. Saxena inaugurated the event. The festival aims to celebrate and conserve the Black-Necked Crane, a species native to the region. This marks a significant initiative for wildlife conservation and tourism promotion in Ladakh.
